subject: general
question: On 11 May 2023, the Uttarakhand Chief Minister launched the ‘Smart School Smart Block Programme’ in the Goralchod auditorium in the state’s ________ district.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Champawat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On May 11, 2023, Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami launched the “Smart School Smart Block Programme” in the Goralchod auditorium in the state's Champawat district. 
 
• The program's goals include: Making teaching more systematic and easy, Developing teachers' capabilities, and Making learning joyful for students. 

 The program was initially implemented in 137 schools of Champawat Block, where 274 teachers were trained to improve the learning outcomes of 5484 children. 

 
• After 100 days of successful implementation, the program was extended to the Khrishu block of Pauri district.
